option.titanium.enabled.tooltip: Render the 3D world at the configured scale.
option.titanium.backend.tooltip: DLSS falls back to Bilinear when the fixed runtime or environment is unavailable.
option.titanium.render_scale.tooltip: World-only scale used by Bilinear. Lower values improve performance but reduce world detail.
option.titanium.dlss_integration.tooltip: Standard uses the standard rendering path. Enhanced coordinates jitter and TAA in supported packs. Supported DLAA paths retain pack TAA on cutout terrain. Unsupported packs or failed analysis fall back to Standard. Switching reloads Iris. Effective state and reason are available through /titanium.
option.titanium.dlss_preset.tooltip: Default delegates model selection to the SDK. Saving recreates the DLSS feature. Older GPUs may incur additional cost. NVIDIA App or driver overrides may take priority.
option.titanium.dlss_sharpness.tooltip: Spatial sharpening of DLSS and DLAA output. Values range from 0.0 to 1.0. A value of 0 disables sharpening.
option.titanium.dlss_terrain_detail.tool: Compensates terrain LOD for the resolution ratio. Without a shaderpack, Default DLAA/Quality also apply opaque-terrain anisotropy. With Iris, supported modes add the resolution LOD delta while preserving pack filtering, alpha testing and settings.
